FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 377
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Frances Holk-Jones
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/13/2026
House Bill 377 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama G.I. Dependents’
Scholarships Program, funded by the Education Trust Fund, by an undetermined amount
dependent on the number of graduate students in a medical field that receive tuition
reimbursement from the program, pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
Under current law, the value of tuition paid per semester hour or equivalent is limited to $400,
and the value of the books and fees paid per semester is limited to $1,000 per student.
Additionally, the child or spouse of a deceased or 100% disabled veteran is limited to a total of
5 academic years of benefits granted, and the spouse of a partially disabled veteran is limited to
3 academic years.
